name: Saxagliptin Hydrochloride

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Diabetic Ketoacidosis in Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus and Other Ketoacidosis : Consider ketone monitoring in patients at risk for ketoacidosis, as indicated. Assess for ketoacidosis regardless of presenting blood glucose levels and discontinue dapagliflozin and saxagliptin if…

summary: Warnings for Saxagliptin Hydrochloride include diabetic ketoacidosis, a serious condition where acids called ketones build up in the blood, and other forms of ketoacidosis [3]. Patients at risk for ketoacidosis may need to have their ketone levels checked, and the medication should be stopped if this condition occurs [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people, assigning low scores for both the liver and the heart [M].
